description: This file implements a Decryption class for handling various cryptographic decryption operations, including symmetric and asymmetric decryption, as well as stream decryption, using the Sodium cryptography library.

classes.name: Decryption
classes.description: A class providing static methods for decrypting data using Sodium cryptography, including symmetric, asymmetric, and stream decryption.

methods.name: transformInput
methods.description: Converts cipher data from string (base64 or hex) or Uint8Array to Uint8Array for decryption.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs symmetric decryption of data with specified output format.

methods.name: decryptAsymmetric
methods.description: Performs asymmetric decryption using a key pair with specified output format.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream for decrypting data chunks using Sodium's secretstream.
